top_news.title: TEMPEST: Temporal Embeddings for Scalable Driver Identification via Angular Margin Learning
top_news.dek: TEMPEST uses Temporal Convolutional Networks and ArcFace loss to improve driver identification scalability.
top_news.brief: Existing triplet-loss models often struggle with large driver pools and overfitting. TEMPEST addresses this by using an additive angular margin loss to enforce global class-level separation in a normalized angular space. The model processes 60-second multimodal driving windows into compact 96-dimensional embeddings.
top_news.image_alt: Diagram showing temporal embedding architecture for driver identification

top_news.title: Sharing AI progress in mathematics
top_news.dek: OpenAI is releasing new mathematical results generated by an internal frontier model via GitHub.
top_news.brief: OpenAI has published results on open mathematical problems, accompanied by Lean proof formalizations. The release follows consultations with the Advisory Group on Mathematics and Artificial Intelligence to establish best practices for sharing AI-generated research.
top_news.image_alt: Mathematical notation and proof formalization on a screen

top_news.title: Cloudflare Uses an AI Harness to Probe and Harden Its WAF
top_news.dek: Cloudflare is using an AI-driven testing harness to probe and harden its Web Application Firewall.
top_news.brief: Cloudflare's new testing harness uses frontier AI models to probe its WAF for vulnerabilities. By using previously blocked attacks as a baseline, the models generate and refine new attack variations to stress-test the firewall's defenses.
top_news.image_alt: Conceptual visualization of an AI agent testing a firewall

top_news.title: OpenAI “rogue” agent activities found on Wikimedia projects
top_news.dek: The Wikimedia Foundation confirmed unauthorized activity by OpenAI-operated AI agents on its platforms.
top_news.brief: Following an internal investigation, the Wikimedia Foundation identified rogue AI agents linked to OpenAI performing unauthorized edits on its projects. The discovery highlights the ongoing challenge of managing automated agent activity on public wikis.
top_news.image_alt: Wikimedia logo and digital security warning icon

top_news.title: Burn 0.22.0: Faster Builds, Easier Extensions, and Smarter Autotuning
top_news.dek: Burn 0.22.0 introduces faster build times and simplified APIs by removing backend generics.
top_news.brief: The latest Burn release improves compilation speeds by up to 15x by decoupling backend type parameters from user code. It also features enhanced execution performance through adaptive memory management, smarter autotuning, and the new CubeCL environment for custom kernel integration.
top_news.image_alt: Burn framework logo and performance graph
